title: Trump Uses Contested Impoundment Power to Cut More HHS Funding
detail: The Trump administration invoked disputed executive impoundment authority to cut additional funding to the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), extending a pattern of contested budget actions that critics argue violates the Congressional Budget and Impoundment Control Act of 1974. The move is part of a broader effort by the administration to unilaterally redirect or withhold congressionally appropriated funds.

media.caption: Trump administration cuts HHS funding using disputed impoundment authority
